categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies legacy BDB migration parsing in src/wallet/migrate.cpp and wallet tests.
categories.rationale: Prevents infinite loops and severe memory inflation during legacy BDB wallet migration from crafted or corrupt database files. PR benchmarks show that on master an ~8 KB crafted file fails to terminate and a 256 KB file drives memory usage to ~800 MB, exposing nodes to DoS via migratewallet.
